name: Anchovy (recruits)
description: Young Cape anchovy (Engraulis encrasicolus) in their first year - the recruit stanza of the source model's two-stanza anchovy. Recruits filter small phytoplankton and microzooplankton low in the food web, and in turn are the single most important prey of seabirds, snoek, hake and seals. Life-stage group of the source's recruit compartment - a single measured stanza, not an aggregate.
